mapper.update: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS user_cage_color_config ( id BIGINT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, user_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, status_code VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, bg_color VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL DEFAULT '#a7f3d0', border_color VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL DEFAULT '#10b981', updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, UNIQUE KEY uk_user_status (user_id, status_code) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4
mapper.select: SELECT status_code AS statusCode, bg_color AS bgColor, border_color AS borderColor FROM user_cage_color_config WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_cage_color_config (user_id, status_code, bg_color, border_color, updated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{statusCode}, #{bgColor}, #{borderColor}, NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE bg_color = VALUES(bg_color), border_color = VALUES(border_color), updated_at = NOW()

INSERT INTO user_cage_color_config (user_id, status_code, bg_color, border_color, updated_at) VALUES
(#{userId}, #{row.statusCode}, #{row.bgColor}, #{row.borderColor}, NOW())
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE bg_color = VALUES(bg_color), border_color = VALUES(border_color), updated_at = NOW()
